title: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
summary: For each query value, return the smallest inclusive size of a closed interval containing it.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100000 intervals and 1–100000 queries. Endpoints and queries are integers in [1,10000000], with start ≤ end.

statement: For each query value, return the smallest inclusive size of a closed interval containing it. Size is end−start+1. Return −1 for an uncovered value and preserve query order.

examples.explanation: The small interval covers 4, and no interval covers 9.
The singleton has size one and answers both repeated queries.
The query falls in a gap.

constraints: 1–100000 intervals and 1–100000 queries. Endpoints and queries are integers in [1,10000000], with start ≤ end.
hints: Conceptual: An interval can cover a query only if it has already started and has not expired.
Directional: Process queries in sorted order, keeping candidate intervals by size.
Implementation: Insert intervals with start ≤ query. Pop expired intervals from the heap top, then write the answer to the original query index.
complexityAnalysis: O((n+q) log(n+q)) time and O(n+q) extra space.
